summary.en: Six deterministic cards covering closed offsets, join styles, stroke outlines, compound paths, automatic strategy selection, and quality scoring.
summary.zh: 六个确定性示例，覆盖闭合路径偏移、连接样式、描边轮廓、复合路径、自动策略选择和质量评分。

description.en: Closed paths can be offset outward or inward. The source shape stays visible so distance and direction are easy to compare.
description.zh: 闭合路径可以向外或向内偏移。源形状会保留显示，方便比较距离和方向。

cards.code:
const expanded = offset(source, 18, { join: 'round' });
const contracted = offset(source, -18, { join: 'round' });

title.en: Joins decide how corners are rebuilt
title.zh: 连接样式决定角点如何重建

description.en: Miter, bevel, and round joins produce different corner geometry. Miter joins also respect the configured limit.
description.zh: miter、bevel 和 round 会生成不同的角点几何；miter 还会受 limit 限制。

title.zh: 描边可以转成可填充轮廓

description.en: offsetStroke handles open and closed paths. Open-path terminals use butt or round caps.
description.zh: offsetStroke 支持开放路径和闭合路径；开放路径端点可以使用 butt 或 round cap。

description.en: Compound paths are normalized before and after offsetting, which helps repeated offsets stay coherent.
description.zh: 复合路径在偏移前后会经过规范化处理，这能让重复偏移保持更稳定。

title.zh: auto 会选择更干净的结果

description.en: The auto strategy compares candidate results with the same scoring function exposed by analyze.
description.zh: auto 策略会用 analyze 暴露的同一套评分函数比较候选结果。

title.en: Quality warnings make hard cases inspectable
title.zh: 质量警告让困难 case 可检查

description.en: analyze reports score, self-intersections, containment errors, and other warning signals for generated paths.
description.zh: analyze 会报告评分、自交、包含错误和其他结果质量信号。
